sourceContract: Claude Code session transcript JSONL (one record per line), read for record and field names only: assistant records carry message.model and message.usage, subagent records are flagged isSidechain, and locally generated assistant records use the model "<synthetic>". Stored here as a JSON object whose `records` array the tests write out one per line.
author: otel-hook claude-code provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Shape only. Every value is invented: session, uuid, request, message and tool ids are fabricated, text is placeholder sentences, paths are under a fictional /workspace/contract-repo, model ids are fictional claude-synthetic-* names, and inference_geo is a placeholder. Token counts are round numbers chosen to satisfy the invariants in docs/claude-code-usage-contract.md (TTL buckets and iterations summing to the outer counters); none is a measurement. No transcript content was copied.
licenseBasis: Original synthetic authorship: record and field names reproduce a third-party CLI's on-disk transcript format, all values are this repository's own.
notes: The tail a wrapping harness reads at Stop (issue #64): the last top-level, non-synthetic assistant record (msg_contract_0002) is the one whose model and usage get attached; the sidechain and <synthetic> records after it must be skipped, and the earlier tool_use record's usage is not summed in. Exercised by tests/providers/claude/transcript.test.ts and tests/e2e-proof/proof-run.test.ts.
